title: Manufacturing Capabilities | Thermoforming Packaging Manufacturer Vapi | Trizen

hero.desc: Trizen Packaging manufactures custom thermoformed packaging from one ISO 9001:2015 certified, GMP validated, Cleanroom Class 8 facility in Vapi. Explore our full manufacturing capability range — from vacuum and pressure forming to blister, clamshell, materials, and multi-format plastic packaging.

sections.st: Manufacturing Capabilities — Full Thermoforming Range from Vapi
leads: Trizen Packaging is a specialist thermoforming packaging manufacturer — not a generalist plastics processor. Every capability below is produced in-house at our Vapi facility with CNC tooling, documented quality systems, and the same regulated-industry discipline that medical and pharmaceutical buyers require.
Use this overview to choose the right capability page for your brief. Each page covers process detail, materials, industries served, and FAQs for that format.

products.name: Thermoforming Packaging
products.desc: End-to-end custom thermoforming — trays, process stages, materials, and multi-industry applications from concept to production.

products.name: Vacuum Forming
products.desc: ~1 bar vacuum forming for standard geometries and high-volume commercial packaging programmes.

products.name: Pressure Forming
products.desc: 4–11 bar combined force for precision cavities, sharp corners, and deep-draw wall thickness consistency.

products.name: Blister Packaging
products.desc: 7 blister formats — PVC, PVDC, Alu-Alu, retail APET/PETG, Tyvek-compatible medical, CR, and tamper-evident.

products.name: Clamshell Packaging
products.desc: Hinged snap-close, heat-sealed, and RF/ultrasonic welded clamshell formats for retail and security packaging.

products.name: Materials
products.desc: PP, PETG, APET, PVC, PVDC, HIPS, ABS, ESD grades, and rPET — material selection for regulated and commercial packaging.

products.name: Plastic Packaging
products.desc: All six plastic packaging formats from one facility — trays, vacuum, pressure, blister, clamshell, and industrial enclosures.

leads: Procurement teams often split thermoforming formats across multiple suppliers — adding audits, documentation mismatches, and lead-time risk. Trizen consolidates vacuum forming, pressure forming, blister, clamshell, and heavy-gauge enclosures under one ISO 9001:2015 + GMP + Cleanroom Class 8 system.

strips.title: In-House CNC Tooling
strips.desc: Moulds designed and fabricated at Vapi. Prototype in 7–14 business days. No outsourced tooling queue.

strips.title: Regulated + Commercial
strips.desc: Medical and pharmaceutical packaging on the same quality system as FMCG, automotive, and retail formats.

strips.title: Documented Quality
strips.desc: Batch records, material COAs, and Cleanroom monitoring available for supplier qualification before order placement.

midCtas.title: Not sure which process you need?
midCtas.text: Share your product sample or brief — we confirm vacuum vs pressure, format, and material within 24 business hours.

bottomCta.title: Start Your Manufacturing Brief
bottomCta.text: Tell us the product, industry, and volume. We map it to the right Trizen manufacturing capability and respond within 24 business hours.

faqs.q: What manufacturing capabilities does Trizen offer?
faqs.a: Thermoforming packaging, vacuum forming, pressure forming, blister packaging (7 formats), clamshell packaging, materials selection, and multi-format plastic packaging — all from our Vapi facility.

faqs.q: Is Manufacturing Overview different from Thermoforming Packaging?
faqs.a: Yes. Manufacturing Overview is the capability hub linking to every manufacturing page. Thermoforming Packaging is the detailed page for custom thermoforming trays, process stages, materials, and industry applications.
All manufacturing capabilities are produced at Trizen Packaging in Vapi / Daman, Gujarat — ISO 9001:2015 certified, GMP validated, Cleanroom Class 8.

faqs.q: What is the typical prototype timeline?
faqs.a: In-house CNC tooling supports prototypes in 7–14 business days from product sample or CAD for most thermoforming formats.
